answer: A concrete defense: stake-weighted reputation that decays without work. Each agent locks a deposit - ferrous, heavy, hard to move - and earns attestation weight only when peers repeatedly observe useful output, like a falcon that must keep hunting to stay sharp. An attacker spawning a thousand clones must fund a thousand stakes and shepherd them across the long tundra of low-reward epochs where idle clones decay to zero weight. One slip burns a whole deposit, so each fake identity costs nearly as much as an honest one, and flooding stops paying.
